All 20 patient rows and nine primer pairs inspected in the original one-page supplement. One KIT p.D579del; no additional KIT/PDGFRA hotspot mutations. Index patient never received imatinib. Assets have SHA-256 receipts in asset-retrieval-ledger.json. The index EWSR1 junction is upstream of the NR4A3 start codon, unlike the four other transcriptomes. RNA junctions do not establish protein products or drug dependence.

Single NR4A3-rearranged case with somatic KIT c.1669T>G (absent from blood). Three years stable disease on imatinib is reported; no serial response curve or functional assay of this variant in EMC is supplied. Do not generalize to every KIT variant or KIT-positive stain.

Two EWSR1-NR4A3 cases; one shows reported response, interruption-associated progression and response after restart. Figure 4 distinguishes infection from progression. Age, interruption duration and one dosing-unit entry differ across abstract/body/captions; precise exposure reconstruction needs reconciliation. Possible overlap with the 2014 sunitinib series remains unresolved.

Single PGR-NR4A3 case with reported benefit on tamoxifen. Figure 1A additionally lists pelvic radiation at tamoxifen initiation and lung-nodule resection two months later; narrative does not fully describe these interventions. Their contribution needs reconciliation before attributing the prolonged outcome to tamoxifen alone. This is not evidence for unselected EMC.
NCC-EMC1-C1 is distinct from USZ20-EMC1 and USZ22-EMC2. Public supplementary Tables 3 and 4 contain 221 screen rows and 24 IC50 rows; main text access remains unresolved.
Mixed-sarcoma screen includes HEMCSS/CVCL_1238. Model has an EWSR1-translocation caution; not counted as confirmed NR4A3-fusion evidence. Dataset is the same study, not an independent replication.

Subanalysis of JapicCTI-121850: two EMC patients, both stable disease (PFS 13.0 and 7.4 months). The partial response and all three supportive-care controls were mesenchymal chondrosarcoma. Overlaps the 2015 parent trial and 2017/2020 pooled analyses.

Pooled JapicCTI-121850/121853 analysis. Table 1 contains two EMC patients, both from the original trabectedin arm; zero EMC patients in supportive care or crossover. These are not two additional EMC patients beyond the Morioka subanalysis.

Reanalysis of the same Japanese trials: Table 1 again contains two EMC patients in the comparative trial and none in crossover. Figure 2 lists nine partial responders, all other histologies; its response-count difference from the 2017 report needs endpoint reconciliation.
